This paper tackles a key challenge towards these LLMs: the current inability of LLMs to effectively adjust their responses across grade levels. To bridge this gap, we developed EDUADAPT, a benchmark of nearly 48k QA pairs (comprising both multiple-choice and open-ended questionanswers) for Grades 1-12 across nine educational subjects...
